sentences.text: Dy javë pas udhëtimit në Korçë, Ana dhe Sami u nisën herët në mëngjes për në fshatin e plakut.
sentences.english: Two weeks after the trip to Korça, Ana and Sam set off early in the morning for the old man's village.

sentences.text: Kishin premtuar që do ta merrnin, dhe të dy ishin pak të shqetësuar, sepse nuk dinin nëse ai do të ndërronte mendje.
sentences.english: They had promised that they would fetch him, and both were a little worried, because they did not know whether he would change his mind.

sentences.text: Autobusi ishte bosh, dhe rruga, që herën e kaluar kishte mjegull, tani ishte plot diell.
sentences.english: The bus was empty, and the road, which last time had had mist, was now full of sun.

sentences.text: Kur zbritën, plaku ishte atje.
sentences.english: When they got off, the old man was there.

sentences.text: Qëndronte para shtëpisë së tij me një xhaketë të vjetër, të pastruar me kujdes, dhe me kapelën në dorë.
sentences.english: He was standing in front of his house in an old jacket, carefully cleaned, with his hat in his hand.

sentences.text: Ana nuk i tha asgjë për xhaketën.
sentences.english: Ana said nothing to him about the jacket.

sentences.text: Vetëm i tha: — Duket se po shkoni në një festë, baba.
sentences.english: She only said: "It looks that you are going to a celebration, father."

sentences.text: — Është xhaketa që kisha për dasmën time, — u përgjigj ai, dhe buzëqeshi pak.
sentences.english: 'It is the jacket I had for my wedding,' he answered, and smiled a little.

sentences.text: — Mari ma kishte pastruar për çdo festë.
sentences.english: "Mari had cleaned it for me for every holiday."

sentences.text: Në autobus ai nuk foli shumë.
sentences.english: On the bus he did not speak much.

sentences.text: Mbante një shishe të vogël me mjaltë, dhe e shikonte nga dritarja malin që po largohej.
sentences.english: He held a small bottle of honey, and looked out of the window at the mountain moving away.

sentences.text: — Nuk kam qenë në qytet prej katër vitesh, — tha ai pas pak.
sentences.english: "I have not been in the city for four years," he said after a while.

sentences.text: — Kur vdiq Mari, mendova se qyteti ishte vetëm për ata që kanë ku të shkojnë.
sentences.english: "When Mari died I thought the city was only for those who have somewhere to go."

sentences.text: — Sot kam ku të shkoj, — tha ai më pas, duke e shikuar Anën.
sentences.english: "Today I have somewhere to go," he said afterwards, looking at Ana.

sentences.text: Kisha ishte plot njerëz, sepse atë të diel kishte një festë të vogël të shkollës së së dielës.
sentences.english: The church was full of people, because that Sunday there was a small celebration of the Sunday school.

sentences.text: Fëmijët, mes tyre Ardi, Elira dhe Gjergji, kishin përgatitur një këngë, dhe Drita, e veshur me xhaketën e saj më të mirë, qëndronte në pjesën e parë me një çantë me bukë.
sentences.english: The children, among them Ardi, Elira and Gjergj, had prepared a song, and Drita, dressed in her best jacket, stood in the front with a bag of bread.

sentences.text: Kur plaku hyri në derë, njerëzit nuk e njihnin, por Drita e pa që nga larg.
sentences.english: When the old man came in at the door, the people did not know him, but Drita saw him from afar.

sentences.text: Ajo u ngrit dhe shkoi drejt tij me hapa të shpejtë, si ta njihte prej vitesh.
sentences.english: She got up and went straight to him with quick steps, as if she had known him for years.

sentences.text: — Mirë se vini, baba, — tha.
sentences.english: "Welcome, father," she said.

sentences.text: — Uluni këtu, pranë meje.
sentences.english: "Sit here, beside me."

sentences.text: — Unë shes bukë, dhe nuk kam njohur kurrë njeri që ka ardhur me dorë bosh në këtë kishë.
sentences.english: "I sell bread, and I have never known anyone who came to this church with empty hands."

sentences.text: — Ju jeni miku ynë.
sentences.english: "You are our friend."

sentences.text: Plaku u ul dhe ia dha shishen me mjaltë pastorit, që e mori me të dy duart.
sentences.english: The old man sat down and gave the bottle of honey to the pastor, who took it with both hands.

sentences.text: Shërbimi filloi me një këngë të vjetër, që njerëzit e dinin përmendësh.
sentences.english: The service began with an old song that the people knew by heart.

sentences.text: Plaku nuk e dinte, por e lëvizte gojën, dhe në vargun e dytë filloi të këndonte ngadalë, me një zë të thyer.
sentences.english: The old man did not know it, but he moved his mouth, and in the second line he began to sing slowly, in a broken voice.

sentences.text: Sami e shikoi Anën.
sentences.english: Sam looked at Ana.

sentences.text: Ajo kishte lot në sy dhe buzëqeshte.
sentences.english: She had tears in her eyes and was smiling.

sentences.text: Në fund të këngës plaku qëndroi i ngritur ndërsa të gjithë u ulën.
sentences.english: At the end of the song the old man remained standing while everyone sat down.

sentences.text: — Pastor, — tha ai me zë të ulët, — mund të them diçka?
sentences.english: "Pastor," he said in a low voice, "may I say something?"

sentences.text: — Sigurisht, baba, — tha pastori.
sentences.english: "Of course, father," said the pastor.

sentences.text: Plaku mori frymë thellë dhe e tha me zë të lartë lutjen që e kishte mësuar nga gjyshja e tij, fjalë për fjalë, siç e kishte thënë natën për më shumë se gjashtëdhjetë vite.
sentences.english: The old man took a deep breath and said aloud the prayer he had learned from his grandmother, word for word, as he had said it at night for more than sixty years.

sentences.text: Kisha heshti.
sentences.english: The church was silent.

sentences.text: Kur mbaroi, nuk u dëgjua asgjë për një moment, pastaj dikush tha «po», dhe të gjithë e thanë bashkë.
sentences.english: When he finished, nothing was heard for a moment, then someone said 'yes,' and everyone said it together.

sentences.text: Pastori nuk tha një predikim atë ditë.
sentences.english: The pastor did not give a sermon that day.

sentences.text: U ngrit, e shikoi plakun dhe tha vetëm: — Faleminderit që na e dhe këtë dhuratë.
sentences.english: He stood up, looked at the old man and said only: "Thank you for giving us this gift."

sentences.text: — Kjo lutje ka jetuar në një shtëpi dhe në një zemër shumë vite pa u dëgjuar nga askush.
sentences.english: "This prayer lived in one house and in one heart for many years without being heard by anyone."

sentences.text: — Sot e ka dëgjuar gjithë kisha, dhe nuk është më e vetme.
sentences.english: 'Today the whole church has heard it, and it is no longer alone.'

sentences.text: Fëmijët e kënduan këngën e tyre, dhe Elira, që ishte në mes të tyre, e shikonte plakun gjatë gjithë kohës.
sentences.english: The children sang their song, and Elira, who was among them, looked at the old man the whole time.

sentences.text: Kur mbaruan, ajo erdhi pranë tij dhe i dha një lule të vogël prej letre që e kishte bërë vetë.
sentences.english: When they finished, she came to him and gave him a small flower of paper that she had made herself.

sentences.text: — Për Mari, — tha.
sentences.english: "For Mari," she said.

sentences.text: Plaku e mori lulen me dy gishta, si të ishte prej xhami.
sentences.english: The old man took the flower with two fingers, as if it were made of glass.

sentences.text: — Mari do ta kishte vënë në dritare, — tha ai.
sentences.english: "Mari would have put it in the window," he said.

sentences.text: — Do ta vë unë.
sentences.english: "I will put it there."

sentences.text: Në rrugën për t'u kthyer autobusi ishte plot, por plaku nuk e ndjeu.
sentences.english: On the way to go back the bus was full, but the old man did not notice.

sentences.text: Ndenji i qetë pranë dritares, me lulen e letrës në xhep, dhe herë pas here e prekte me gisht.
sentences.english: He sat quietly by the window, with the paper flower in his pocket, and now and then touched it with his finger.

sentences.text: — Të dielën tjetër do të vij përsëri, — tha ai kur zbritën.
sentences.english: "Next Sunday I will come again," he said when they got off.

sentences.text: — Por këtë herë do të vij vetë.
sentences.english: "But this time I will come by myself."

sentences.text: Ana dhe Sami u kthyen në qytet pa folur, të dy të qetë dhe të gëzuar.
sentences.english: Ana and Sam went back to the city without speaking, both calm and glad.
